references.text: The sons of Makir, the son of Manasseh, went to Gilead and captured it, driving out the Amorites who lived there. Moses gave Gilead to Makir, the son of Manasseh.
Mentions the victory over Og, king of Bashan, who ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Describes the conquest of Og's kingdom in Bashan, including the cities of Ashtaroth and Edrei, and that half of Gilead was given to the Makirites.
Mentions all the cities on the plain, all of Gilead and all of Bashan up to Salcah and Edrei, cities in Og's kingdom in Bashan.
The rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og's kingdom, Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasseh.
Describes Og, king of Bashan, as one of the Rephaites who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei, and his territory.
Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Manasseh, specifically that Makir, the firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead, received Gilead and Bashan because he was a warrior.
Describes Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, at Edrei.
Mentions Ashtaroth-Karnaim as a place where the Rephaites were defeated.
